It's time for Swimpardy!
Carson Foster, Caspar Corbeau and Shaine Casas take on the ultimate swimming quiz, hosted by John Mason!
From questions about the Silk Road Tour hosts and the Swimming World Cup to swimming techniques, records and figures, it's a battle of swimming knowledge.
Who comes out on top? Watch until the end to find out – and play along yourself to see how many questions you can get right!
